gpu_monitor.note: Device-wide nvidia-smi samples (not process-exclusive); on multi-GPU systems samples aggregate all GPU rows and must be interpreted accordingly.

temporal.note: Per-sample scores apply the official logistic to each sampled frame's raw quality1 prediction. This is a PixVQA extension of the published video-level model, not an officially validated per-frame predictor. QCS from these samples describes sampled-frame consistency at the configured sampling interval, not frame-by-frame consistency.
